presentation.label: QUICK MOD ASSIGN
presentation.summary: Link a parameter to velocity or aftertouch by holding FIX or SAMPLER and turning its knob.
presentation.overview: Hold FIX and turn any knob on a sound page: that parameter is linked to velocity, and the turn sets how much. Hold SAMPLER and turn to link it to aftertouch instead. While either key is held, every linked knob shows its amount the way stock shows a performance lock, with a V or an A in the top-left corner. It fills stock's own four velocity and four aftertouch slots of the selected sound, so the links save with the kit, show in SOUND SETTINGS as usual and keep playing on a unit without the mod.
highlights: Velocity or aftertouch to any parameter in one gesture
Stays on the page you are playing
Uses stock's slots, saved with the kit
usage: Hold FIX and turn FILTER FRQ to make harder hits open the filter.
Hold SAMPLER and turn AMP DEC to let pad pressure lengthen the decay.

access.location: The FIX and SAMPLER keys, on a sound track's pages and in PERF, SCNE, MUTE and CHRO.
steps: Select a sound track and open its SYNTH, SAMPLE, FILTER, AMP or LFO page.
Hold FIX: linked knobs show their velocity amounts and a V sits in the top-left corner. Turn a knob to link it or change its amount.
Hold SAMPLER for aftertouch: an A, and the aftertouch amounts.
Turn back to 0 to free the slot. Tap FIX alone to toggle fixed velocity, tap SAMPLER alone to open the recorder, as before.

limitations: Each sound has four velocity and four aftertouch slots; with all four in use a popup says SLOTS FULL.
A FIX tap toggles fixed velocity on the release instead of the press.
While FIX or SAMPLER is held, the TRIG page's knobs and knobs turned with a trig held do nothing.
FUNC + FIX, the FX track and a pad held in PERF or SCNE keep stock's behaviour.

claims: ui:FIX + knob on the sound pages
ui:SAMPLER + knob on the sound pages
ui:FIX tap toggles fixed velocity on the release
ui:the screen's top-left corner while FIX or SAMPLER is held

load.conditions: UI only: runs on key events and knob turns, never in the audio path.
